WITH BASE_TABLE AS ( SELECT DISTINCT SM.serial_no , SD.id FROM stock_type_master STM /* 参照権限を考慮する場合に用いる INNER JOIN stock_type_data STD ON STM.stock_type = STD.stock_type AND STM.stock_code = STD.stock_code*/ INNER JOIN stock_master SM ON STM.stock_type = SM.stock_type AND STM.stock_code = SM.stock_code AND STM.del = FALSE AND SM.del = FALSE /* 棚卸のため、INNER JOINとする */ INNER JOIN stock_data SD ON SM.serial_no = SD.serial_no /* 返却済データの除去 ≒ 最新の備品データを取得 */ AND SD.return_date IS NULL AND SD.del = FALSE WHERE 1 = 1 )
SELECT SM.serial_no AS serialNo , STM.name AS type_name , IFNULL(SM.name, '') AS model , CASE WHEN SM.rent_flg THEN '4' -- 不可 / 貸出可否(TRUEの場合、貸出不可) WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE (), SD.confirmed_date) > 365 THEN '3' -- 不明 / [confirmed_date]：最終所在確認日 が１年前以前(可・貸出中に関わらず不明とする) WHEN SD.staff_no IS NOT NULL AND (DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), SD.confirmed_date) <= 365 ) THEN '2' -- 貸出中 WHEN SD.staff_no IS NULL AND (DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), SD.confirmed_date) <= 365 ) THEN '1' -- 可 ELSE '4' -- 不可 / 備品データが未登録の場合など、異常なデータ END AS rentFlg , IFNULL(STF.name, '') AS staffName -- 貸出先ユーザー , IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(SD.start_date, '%Y/%m/%d'), '-') AS startDate , IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(SD.limit_date, '%Y/%m/%d'), '-') AS limitDate , IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(SD.confirmed_date, '%Y/%m/%d'), '-') AS confirmedDate , SM.remarks AS remarks
, '2026/03/18' AS inventoryDate
, SM.remarks AS remarksMasterValue -- 更新比較用に現在の「備考」の値を取得ー , SD.id AS stockDataId FROM BASE_TABLE B INNER JOIN stock_master SM ON B.serial_no = SM.serial_no INNER JOIN stock_type_master STM ON SM.stock_type = STM.stock_type AND SM.stock_code = STM.stock_code
/* 棚卸のため、INNER JOINとする */ INNER JOIN stock_data SD ON B.id = SD.id
/* 未登録データを考慮しLEFT JOINとする */ LEFT JOIN staff_master STF ON SD.staff_no = STF.staff_no
WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY STM.stock_type , STM.stock_code , SM.serial_no
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_data SET confirmed_date = STR_TO_DATE( #{confirmedDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') WHERE id = #{stockDataId}
mapper.select: SELECT EDV.シリアルナンバー AS serialNo, EDV.使用者 AS staffName, EDV.貸出可否 AS rentFlg, -- 貸出可否の文字列が設定されている想定 EDV.貸出開始日 AS startDate, EDV.返却予定日 AS limitDate, EDV.最終所在確認日 AS confirmedDate, EDV.製品名 AS model, EDV.メーカー AS maker, EDV.接続先PCシリアルナンバー AS destinationSerialNo, EDV.分類 AS type, EDV.リース返却予定日 AS leaseDate, EDV.備考 AS remarks, EDV.stock_type, EDV.stock_code, EDV.備品データID, AS stockDataId, EDV.社員番号 AS staff_no FROM equip_detail_view EDV WHERE 1 = 1 AND EDV.stock_type = #{type} AND EDV.stock_code = #{code} ORDER BY EDV.シリアルナンバー
SELECT STM.name FROM stock_type_master STM WHERE 1 = 1 AND STM.stock_type = #{type} AND STM.stock_code = #{code}
SELECT IFNULL( GCM.value_1, '1') AS windowSize FROM generic_code_master GCM WHERE 1 = 1 AND GCM.type_key = #{type} AND GCM.code = #{code}
